metadata.title: Topology and Dirichlet spectrum of free boundary minimal and CMC surfaces
metadata.abstract: We find bounds for the genus and for the number of boundary components of a surface that is either index one as a free boundary minimal surface or stable as a free boundary constant mean curvature surface in a Riemannian three-manifold with convex boundary and non-negative Ricci curvature, provided the first Dirichlet eigenvalue of its Jacobi operator is non-negative. As an application, we establish strong topological restrictions on such surfaces in compact strictly convex domains of three-dimensional normal homogeneous spaces.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.progressType: 自由边界曲面的拓扑与谱约束
analysis.workSummary: 在凸边界、非负 Ricci 的三流形中，对指数一自由边界极小曲面或稳定 CMC 曲面给出亏格和边界分支数界，条件包括 Jacobi 算子的首 Dirichlet 特征值非负。
techniques: 三维正规齐性空间应用
analysis.breakthrough: 把谱条件转化为可用于具体凸域的拓扑限制。
analysis.limitations: 附加 Dirichlet 谱条件不能由自由边界稳定性直接替代；界的具体形式待核对。 当前为摘要级数学分析，主结果和证明尚未逐段核查；AI 披露另见独立核查记录。
analysis.priorityReason: 谱与拓扑之间的定量接口适合极小曲面和 CMC 读者。
